title: Shin Hati
subtitle: Independent
description: Young and still with much to learn, Shin Hati was eager to please her master, Baylan Skoll. Hati served as a capable apprentice who did not often disappoint. Adept in her Lightsaber skills as well as being an able pilot, she rose to every challenge presented to her and often met Sabine Wren in intense hand-to-hand combat.
